digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler — summary update retry budget and outcome contract
propositions: Nested retries across subprocess/SDK/wrapper can multiply Jira writes or leave acceptance ambiguous; a single provider-neutral retry budget with observe-before-replay recovery must replace them.

Cloud and DC summary-write routes must each execute at most three physical invocations within 15 seconds cumulative sleep (fallback [2s,3s) then [4s,5s)) with one logical id, desired postcondition, and bounded redacted diagnostics (≤8 entries, ≤512 code points each).

DC summary write is GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats; ambiguous PUT triggers separate GET observation; desired state observed after timeout is recovered success; failed/inconclusive returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Cloud recovery uses primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest with one attempt and no sleep; DC wrapper calls use one-attempt/no-sleep policy; legacy callers and unselected routes preserve current retry behavior.

Constructor-injected executor selector defaults to legacy (no config/env key); exact {"summary"} bypasses legacy _call_with_retry; mixed fields stay one legacy call; tests explicitly enable new route; Jira 3.10.5 client built with max_retries=0 must pass _session.max_retries == 0 validation.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one completion log (≤1,024 code points) with only logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message (≤512 code points); ADR 0103 records contract, ownership, and compatibility deltas; S3 owns cutover and fuse control; S5 owns live confirmation.
